sentences.text: Learned Additional Government Advocate submits that in obedience to the aforesaid direction issued by this Designation: Junior Stenographer Court, the Additional District Magistrate-cum- Reason: Authentication Location: OHC Date: 11-Nov-2025 17:50:36

Adjudicating Authority under the FSS Act/Opposite Party No. 3 has duly disposed of Adjudication Case No.02 of 2016 by passing a detailed and reasoned Order dated 16.07.2025 wherein the proceeding initiated against the Petitioner in the Writ Petition has been dropped.
4. He further submits that the delay caused in the matter was completely unintentional and not deliberate.

The said adjudication Case had been initiated in the year 2016 and the present deponent came to Join in his post as the Additional District Magislrate-cum-Adjudicating Authority under the FSS Act on 18.10.2022.

As the aforesaid proceeding has already been disposed of/dropped and the direction issued by this Court vide Judgment and Order dated 20.06.2025 has been complied with,
the Opposite Party No.3 prays that the cost imposed by this Court as contained in paragraph No. 16 of the order dated 20.06.2025 be modified/waived.

sentences.text: 1 5 . Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Opposite Parties/State and the averments made in this I.A, since the adjudication was delayed for a long period of 9 years, this Court cannot condone such delay caused by the adjudicating authority.
Hence, the prayer for waiving off the cost is rejected.
Designation: Junior Stenographer 6.
However, it is made clear that this Court has not passed any adverse remark or fasten any responsibility on the incumbent officer personally as he has joined recently.
Hence, cost be borne by the Government of Odisha and not by the officer concerned.
7. The I.A. is, accordingly, disposed of.
(Dr. Sanjeeb K Panigrahi) Judge Gitanjali Designation: Junior Stenographer M/S.
